subject: world_language
concept: Producing sophisticated, publication-quality writing in the target language across genres
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C2 'sophisticated writing' extension — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a sophisticated piece using a genre-appropriate organizer in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student produces a polished, sophisticated piece of writing in a chosen genre in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: piece demonstrates near-native command of structure, vocabulary, and genre conventions
misconception_flags: piece is grammatically correct but reads as a translated or simplified version rather than genuinely native-level prose

interest_binding: genre/topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
